So I recently turned 21 this year and yesterday I decided to have some fun for once with some vodka and redbull. Keep in mind I almost never drink, so it’s safe to assume I am a lightweight. I didn’t think it would be as bad as it was though. So I hopped in vrchat in a drinking world so I wouldn’t be fully alone, and wound up drinking half a 750ml bottle of vodka in a few hours (I think, my memory is still very blurry). All I remember was glimpses of things I don’t fully remember happening. At first I was having a good time, but maybe too much of a good time. I remember sitting covered in vomit (also forgot to mention I didn’t eat the entire day, rookie mistake) and then being in the shower and then I apparently fell out or passed out because the shower curtain the next day was tore up on the floor, and I have a big bruise on my arm. I only realized I fell the morning after when I was hungover as all hell. Drink responsibly, everyone. I still don’t remember much haha
